qaFiles.purpose: QA report presentation; only local report and vendor URLs adapted
QA report presentation; only local report, vendor and documentation URLs adapted

qaInvocation: Unmodified pinned motion-qa-v1/run.mjs --library soccer-run-cycles-v3 --fps 120; only source inventory adapted.
coordinateSpace: Native zero-root GLB plus explicit external actor scenario applied once. Untransformed pose and rotations retained for continuity.
limitations: Skeleton and declared sole/contact points are audited; compressed mesh geometry and texture pixels are not decoded.
Reference-root paths describe the author scenario. Actual simulation speed/IK/blending are not executed.
Feeling score is a reproducible weighted diagnostic heuristic, not a perceptual or medical validation.
Missing applicable metadata is unavailable and earns zero points; not-applicable metrics are excluded. Coverage is shown.

evidence.probeKind: declared sole probes plus skeletal joint centers (no mesh surfaces)

evidence.alignment: horizontal root translation; raw asset poses used when provided

evidence.note: Motion is mirrored in a pelvis-centred body basis.

refereeRates.method: Measured time reparameterization: pose, contacts and external trajectory use t*rate together. No spatial scaling.
